_comment: Regional climate profiles for house planning. Do not hardcode these values in application code. Always read from this file.

central_israel.label: מרכז ישראל
central_israel.notes: Hot-dry summers, mild winters. South-facing living areas optimal. Shade pergolas on west recommended.

northern_israel.label: צפון ישראל
northern_israel.notes: More rainfall, cooler winters. Windbreak from northwest direction important. Good natural ventilation.

southern_israel.label: דרום ישראל
southern_israel.notes: Extreme summer heat. Maximum shading and thermal mass critical. North-facing or shaded courtyards preferred.

orientation_rationale.south: Maximum winter sun exposure for passive solar heating
orientation_rationale.east: Morning sun — comfortable for bedrooms and kitchens
orientation_rationale.north: Diffuse light — no direct sun, good for utility areas
orientation_rationale.west: Afternoon sun — can cause overheating in summer, use shading
